dialogue.intro: The northern pass into the Frostreach is sealed by old magic. Bring me proof you've bested the Scorched Wastes and I'll open the way.
dialogue.incomplete: Still no word from the Wastes. Come back once you've claimed what's guarded there.
dialogue.success: An Ember-Charred Fragment -- so it's true. The northern pass is open to you now. The Frostreach awaits, adventurer.

dialogue.intro: The western ruins of Stormfell answer to nothing but a storm's own fury -- and proof from the Frostreach, if you've truly walked it.
dialogue.incomplete: The ruins stay dark without word from the Frostreach. Bring me what's guarded there.
dialogue.success: A Frost-Bound Fragment -- the Frostreach is truly conquered, then. The western ruins are open. Mind the lightning in Stormfell, adventurer.

dialogue.intro: South of here the Fenmire swallows every path whole -- but I'll open a way through the bog, if you've truly weathered Stormfell's storms.
dialogue.incomplete: The bog stays sealed without word from Stormfell. Bring me what's guarded there.
dialogue.success: A Storm-Cloven Fragment -- Stormfell answers to you now. The Fenmire's paths are open. Watch your footing in the bog, adventurer.

dialogue.intro: Four fragments, four corners of the frontier -- if the Fenmire has truly yielded its own, you hold everything the old seal at the world's heart was built to keep out.
dialogue.incomplete: The seal answers to all four fragments together, not three. Find what the Fenmire guards.
dialogue.success: Ember, frost, storm, and mire, all in one hand -- the seal breaks. What waits beyond is yours to face, adventurer. Go carefully.
